tasks.label: Install
tasks.detail: Build, install on the USB device, and launch
tasks.command: .\gradlew.bat installDebug; if ($?) { adb shell am start -n com.resumelens/.MainActivity }

tasks.label: Logcat
tasks.detail: Stream logs from the running app only
tasks.command: $appPid = adb shell pidof -s com.resumelens; if (-not $appPid) { Write-Host 'App is not running. Run the Install task first.'; exit 1 }; adb logcat -v color --pid=$appPid

tasks.label: Test
tasks.detail: Run JVM unit + Robolectric Compose tests
